description: This file is a REST controller class `CustomerController` for handling customer-related operations in a banking application. It defines endpoints for CRUD operations on customer data, uses Spring annotations for mappings and dependency injection, and interfaces with a service layer `BankingServiceImpl`.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for managing customer information in the banking application.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all customer details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new customer and create an account.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update existing customer details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a customer and their associated accounts.
